en.hubeali:
Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al-Washa, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Ma’mar Bin Yahya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no Salāt on the day of (Eid) Al-Fitr and (Eid) Al-Az’ha, except with a prayer leader’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman from Ma‘mar ibn Yahya who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
There is not any Salah (prayer) on the day of al-Fitr or al- Adha’ except with Imam.”’
